{"findings":[{"label_code":"IP_FRAMEWORK","snippet":"All countries, regardless of their development level, have been progressively strengthening their intellectual property rights (IPR) systems (Campi and Nuvolari, 2015; 2020). UPOV-compliant legislation (De Schutter, 2009).","page_number":4,"reasoning":"Explicitly links plant variety protection with TRIPS, UPOV 1991, and compliance beyond minimum international {"findings":[{"label_code":"IMPLEMENTATION_BARRIERS","snippet":"Nigeria was not a signatory to the International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV) Convention (Okonkwo, et al 2021) which to a large extent impeded the exploitation of such rights.
